name: ddd
description: Domain-driven design and contract completeness for every design session. Subdomain distillation, language-sized bounded contexts, entity/VO/enum-classified domain objects with every field and every relationship carrying a cardinality, constructor-enforced invariants, aggregate discipline with domain events, anti-corruption layers, then API, domain event and DDL contracts each defined to 100% and cross-checked against each other, captured as a context map, a domain model and an ADR before code.
